reference.arithmetic_policy: Exact rational nearest/ties-even binary32 primitives, gradual underflow; fused variants hypothetical, not actual GPU compiler evidence.
reference.bit_encoding: Hexadecimal little-endian4-byte binary32 octets; raw signed-zero inputs retained.
reference.fused_policy: fma_outer/fma_factored use sequential fused dot products and final refract multiply-add; respectively outer1-eta²*(1-facing²) and factored eta²*facing²+(1-eta²). Axis products and k² outer arithmetic remain unfused.
reference.input_policy: Python numeric inputs are explicitly rounded to binary32 first; stored bits feed both replays. Already-binary32 observed inputs and signed zeros remain unchanged.

physical.fresnel_scope: Raw-cosine algebra, not normalized-incident physical calibration.

reference.precision_policy: 80/120digits; per-field abs+rel1e-60; support signs must agree, no support epsilon.
